title: Reading Development
goal: Develop reading from first word recognition to critical reading of articles and extended texts, with strategies for main ideas, context, inference and summarisation.

modules.title: Reading Foundations
modules.description: From word recognition and sentence reading to short passages and dialogues — reading to understand, at A1.

lessons.title: Word Recognition
objectives: Recognise learned vocabulary instantly in new contexts
Use context to read unfamiliar words
lessons.assessment: Recognise 20 of 24 target words in context within time limits

lessons.title: Sentence Reading
objectives: Read sentences with basic fluency
Confirm understanding by matching sentences to pictures and paraphrases
lessons.assessment: Read 10 sentences aloud smoothly and match 9 to meanings

checkpoint.criteria: Read words and sentences fluently with demonstrated understanding

lessons.title: Short Passages
objectives: Read a 3-5 sentence passage for basic meaning
Answer literal comprehension questions
lessons.assessment: Answer 8 of 10 literal questions on a short passage

lessons.title: Dialogues
objectives: Read conversational texts and follow who says what
Understand short functional exchanges (shop, bus, phone)
lessons.assessment: Follow a 10-line dialogue and complete 4 comprehension and 2 gap tasks

checkpoint.criteria: Read short passages and dialogues with literal understanding

modules.title: Building Comprehension
modules.description: Longer texts and the core comprehension strategies: paragraph reading, stories, main ideas, context clues and inferencing, at A2.

lessons.title: Paragraph Reading
objectives: Follow a 2-3 paragraph text
Track topic development across paragraphs
lessons.assessment: Answer 8 of 10 questions spanning a 3-paragraph text

lessons.title: Stories
objectives: Follow narrative sequence: beginning, problem, resolution
Retell a story in 5 sentences
lessons.assessment: Retell a read story in 5 ordered sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Read multi-paragraph texts and stories and retell them

lessons.title: Finding Main Ideas
objectives: Find the topic and main idea of a paragraph
Distinguish main ideas from supporting details
lessons.assessment: Identify main ideas of 5 paragraphs and write 2 accurate titles

lessons.title: Understanding Context and Inferencing
objectives: Use context clues for unknown words
Make simple inferences and justify them from the text
lessons.assessment: Infer 8 of 10 word meanings from context and justify 3 inferences

checkpoint.criteria: Find main ideas, use context and make justified inferences

modules.title: Reading Genres
modules.description: Reading across text types — descriptive, informational and articles — building genre awareness, at B1.

lessons.title: Descriptive Passages
objectives: Read descriptions of places, people and processes
Extract sensory and spatial details
lessons.assessment: Extract 10 accurate details from a descriptive passage

lessons.title: Informational Texts
objectives: Read for facts, steps and definitions
Use headings and layout to navigate
lessons.assessment: Complete a fact table from an informational text with 9 of 10 correct

lessons.title: Articles
objectives: Read news-style articles with headline and structure awareness
Separate reported facts from opinions
lessons.assessment: Read an article and classify 10 statements as fact or opinion with 8 correct

checkpoint.criteria: Read the three core genres with genre-appropriate strategies

modules.title: Critical Reading
modules.description: Reading for depth at B2: summarisation, author's purpose and tone, and inference with evaluation.

lessons.title: Summarisation
objectives: Summarise a text in a fixed number of sentences
Select essential information and drop examples and repetition
lessons.assessment: Write a 3-sentence summary of a 300-word text capturing all key points

lessons.title: Author's Purpose and Tone
objectives: Identify why a text was written: inform, persuade, entertain
Read tone from word choice
lessons.assessment: Identify purpose and tone of 5 texts with evidence from word choice

lessons.title: Reading for Meaning: Inference and Evaluation
objectives: Draw and support deeper inferences
Evaluate arguments and evidence quality
lessons.assessment: Answer 8 inference/evaluation questions with textual evidence

checkpoint.criteria: Summarise, infer and evaluate extended texts with evidence

exitAssessment.title: Reading Development Exit Test
exitAssessment.criteria: Read graded texts from A1 to B2: literal and inferential comprehension, main idea identification, context vocabulary, fact versus opinion, summarisation of a 300-word text, and evidence-based inference.
